approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the merge driver match REQ-merge-006: a clean merge keeps what both sides meant, so a list item YAML 1.1 would read as a timestamp when plain stays a quoted string, as numbers, booleans and nulls already do.
acceptance_criteria: A quoted YYYY-MM-DD list item stays a quoted string after a clean union of files in either merge order; a full timestamp stays quoted; a path holding a date stays plain (red then green)
